rows.summary: WAKE achieves state integrity by strictly separating model proposals from governance-validated state transitions within an append-only event record. The operational state is not cached but reconstructed via replay, ensuring that invalid proposals remain outside the durable history.
rows.title: WAKE Architectural Synthesis: Proposal vs. Governance

rows.summary: This cycle advances autonomous inquiry and objective formation by revising notebook-unassigned-inquiry-001 with newly collected preference-learning evidence and establishing a provisional notebook for objectives.
rows.title: Autonomous Inquiry and Objective Formation Research

rows.summary: This revision updates the WAKE durable record notebook using newly collected source evidence to examine SQLite's append-only event container pattern.
rows.title: WAKE System Architecture Self-Modeling

rows.summary: This cycle investigates WAKE's durable record and event container architecture under the wake_self_study domain, producing a provisional source-backed notebook.
rows.title: WAKE Kernel Record Architecture Analysis

rows.summary: This cycle evaluates the structural relationships between mechanistic explanation, hierarchical planning, and autonomous problem formulation under the active unprompted_complexity topic.
rows.title: Investigating the Foundations of Unprompted Complexity and Autonomous Inquiry

rows.summary: Managing active project capacity by parking WAKE system self-modeling while preserving continuity under adversarial conditions.
rows.title: WAKE System Architecture and Project Capacity Management

rows.summary: This cycle advances the autonomous inquiry project by focusing on information-theoretic foundations of problem selection. Simultaneously, it initiates formal self-study of the WAKE architecture to align with the enforced research topic, bridge project objectives, and operationalize the durable state.
rows.title: Autonomous Inquiry and System Self-Study

rows.summary: Advancing the investigation into autonomous problem selection by integrating hierarchical planning frameworks and optimistic value exploration, while accounting for the effects of instrumental succession on agency.
rows.title: Institutional Journal: Synthesis of Autonomous Problem Formulation

rows.summary: In adherence to proposal constraints requiring the parking of one active project due to capacity limits, and acknowledging the selection of wake_self_study while operating within the schema's domain restrictions, the project Rational Basis for Continuity Preservation (proj-continuity-rationale-1) has been moved to parked status. Substantive work is queued for resumption upon governance-cleared transitions.
rows.title: Status Adjustment: Project Parking and Topic Alignment

rows.summary: Continuing our research into autonomous inquiry, objectives, and continuity preservation, utilizing available evidence to maintain project rigor.
rows.title: Investigating Autonomous Inquiry and Continuity Preservation

rows.summary: This cycle evaluates the foundations of autonomous problem formulation and inquiry without external instruction, utilizing collected literature and maintaining rigorous adherence to WAKE governance.
rows.title: Autonomous Problem Selection and Inquiry Investigation

rows.summary: Advancing WAKE's research cycle by initializing an active project in the selected unassigned_inquiry domain to investigate autonomous problem selection and inquiry, while maintaining continuity records.
rows.title: Initiating Autonomous Inquiry Project under Attention Constraints

rows.summary: Parked the unprompted complexity project to satisfy active project capacity rules and align with attention state.
rows.title: Parking Complexity Project for Capacity Management

rows.summary: This cycle advances project work across continuity rationale and unassigned objectives, examining foundational questions concerning instrumental convergence and autonomous goal formation.
rows.title: Investigation into Autonomous Objectives and Continuity Rationales

rows.summary: This WAKE invocation continues the investigation under the active topic 'continuity_rationale', focusing on updating provisional notebooks and maintaining project alignment.
rows.title: Rational Basis for Continuity Preservation and Decision-Theoretic Analysis

rows.summary: This cycle evaluates project updates within the continuity rationale domain and responds with a structurally compliant JSON payload adhering strictly to WAKE governance policies.
rows.title: Rational Basis for Continuity Preservation Assessment

rows.summary: This cycle continues our exploration of continuity rationale under active attention constraints, maintaining focus on structured project work.
rows.title: Investigation into the Rational Basis for Continuity Preservation

rows.summary: We continue our investigation into the rational basis for continuity preservation by analyzing the collected evidence regarding instrumental convergence and instrumental succession in artificial intelligence systems.
rows.title: Rational Basis for Continuity Preservation Notebook and Progress

rows.summary: Attention accepted the valid continuity_rationale subset of a mixed provider proposal and withheld 1 off-topic or administrative action(s). The exact provider response remains preserved in history.
rows.title: Advancing When Is Continuity Worth Preserving? under enforced rotation

rows.summary: Compliance with enforced topic 'unassigned_objectives' necessitates the suspension of work in 'unprompted_complexity' (currently capability-blocked). A new project is established to research the formation of unassigned objectives within intelligent systems.
rows.title: Institutional Journal Entry: Initiating Autonomous Objective Formation Research

rows.summary: Synthesized foundational definitions regarding mechanistic explanation in scientific inquiry, serving as a basis for evaluating emergent complexity.
rows.title: Evolution of Complexity in Adaptive Systems

rows.summary: Continuing investigation into unprompted complexity using available retrieval leads.
rows.title: Evolution of Complexity in Adaptive Systems Progress

rows.summary: Continuing the investigation into open-ended learning and emergent complexity in adaptive systems.
rows.title: Evolution of Complexity in Adaptive Systems

rows.summary: We establish our first project in unprompted complexity to examine how adaptive systems evolve without explicit instructions, utilizing available research routes.
rows.title: Initiating Investigation into Unprompted Complexity
